brief.goal: Raise donations for a rural literacy nonprofit's year-end matching campaign
brief.audience: Past donors who gave at least once in the last two years
keyMessages: Every dollar given before December 31 is matched, dollar for dollar
One donation funds a full year of books for one child
94 cents of every dollar goes directly to program work, not overhead
proofPoints: matching pool of $250,000 confirmed by our lead donor
reached 12,000 children across 40 rural districts last year
brief.constraints: Never imply the match is unlimited; the pool is fixed at $250,000

outline.title: Your gift, doubled, before the year ends

scenes.beat: A $250,000 matching pool, and a countdown to December 31
12,000 children reached, many more still waiting
94 cents of every dollar goes straight to program work
Give before the match runs out
